'''Frostwake Outpost''' was a military bunker used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was located in the [[Frostwake Hills]], on the southwestern edge of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
